notes: Counted by master brief §11 as amended by package B (plan D14), read inside a table (WP-A brief §8.1): a cell's
flow text is not an element, it is the cell's paragraphs. Text on either side of a box that leaves the flow (a
chip, an inline icon or image, a block chip) is a segment of its own; per band of side-by-side paragraphs the
leftmost stays in the cell and each other one is a bandText element. Every chip with text yields a chipText (Peter
#4: its paint is drawn over the table, so its words go over it too). Text elements: the caption, each chipText,
blockChipText and bandText, and the text of an out-of-flow overlay. Shapes: the table surface, each cellGradient
slot, each chip client rect plus one per painted side where the sides differ, each blockChip and decoration as
emitDecoration yields them, the out-of-flow overlay's own paint, SVG expansions.

elements.name: rich

elements.name: flow
